WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS grand_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
status_avgs AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_modindex, o.grand_avg
  FROM status_avgs s
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE s.avg_modindex > o.grand_avg
)
SELECT q.rfistat,
       q.avg_modindex,
       q.avg_modindex - q.grand_avg AS above_average_by,
       q.avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying q
ORDER BY q.avg_modindex DESC;
